title.narrative: Supporting Electricity Generation for Syria’s Recovery - Deir Ali

description.narrative: Support to the maintenance of the Deir Ali Power Plant Extension II by the provision and installation of urgently required replacement spare parts to ensure proper operation. Providing and securing the necessary spare parts will enable the reactivation of non-functional equipment, support maintenance of operational units, and allow for the replacement of damaged or worn-out components. This will help preserve the technical lifespan of the remaining equipment, prevent recurring shutdowns that threaten the integrity of the generation units, and ensure their continued and stable operation. By restoring reliable electricity generation at the Deir Ali power plant, the project improves access to essential services including health, water, and education, for vulnerable populations, and helps ease the humanitarian caseload and reduce reliance on emergency aid. This will contribute to the Humanitarian-Development-Peace (HDP) Nexus, creating conditions for long-term resilience and sustainable development. This approach bridges short-term stabilization efforts with long-term development objectives, contributing to enhanced community resilience and social cohesion in areas affected by crisis and energy insecurity.
